main_text.l: tum desiderata latuissent; tandem inventa, mihique haud parvo ære compara-ta, etiamnum apud me asservantur, publicae utilitati concedenda. Intentus his excudendis erat Joannes van Someren noti nominis Bibliopola: quando primum bello, de hinc sub ipsa pacis pactione morte praeventus; manum operi, in quo ego jam multum sudaveram, admovere non potuit. Eratque in eo Celeberrimus Author noster, ut inter alios suis maxime curis opus dignissimum promoveret. Id quod etiam causae est, cur hic ejus mentionem facere voluerim. Interim hinc tu L. B. facile, quod dixi, intelliges; omni opere nobis annitendum esse, ut ALTINGIUS noster quamprimum absolvatur: atque locum det sui similibus, id est, magni nominis autoribus, magno literatorum hominum commodo, in publicum edendis. Interim his fruere & Vale. Dabam Amstelaedami VI. Iduum Maij MDCLXXXVI.

page.notes: A woodcut vignette of a flower vase with scrollwork, placed in the middle of the page between the text and the catchword, is not transcribed. Faint mirrored text at the top and a faded ghost text in the lower half are show-through from the reverse side and are omitted. A small faint mark near the foot of the text block is not legible and may be a signature or page number, so it is not transcribed. The date "cIↄ Iↄc Lxxxvi" is read as MDCLXXXVI (1686). "Lxxxvi" was set in small capitals and is given here as LXXXVI.
